 ----Petitioner  Versus 1. State Of Rajasthan, Through Pp 2. Suman D/o Pala Ram, R/o Gwaloo, P.s. Kuchera, Dist.
 Nagaur
----Respondents For Petitioner(s) : Mr. Shanker Singh Shekhawat

For Respondent(s) : Mr. Vikram Sharma, P.P.
 HON'BLE MR. JUSTICE KULDEEP MATHUR Order 18/10/2023 This application for bail under Section 439 Cr.P.C. has been filed by the petitioner who has been arrested in connection with F.I.R. No.184/2023 registered at Police Station Kuchera, District Nagaur, for offences under Sections 376(2)(N), 376-D, 354, 342 and 366 of IPC.
Heard learned counsel for the petitioner and learned Public Prosecutor.
Perused the material available on record.
Learned counsel for the petitioner submitted that the petitioner has been falsely implicated in this case.

Learned counsel submitted that the allegation against the present petitioner is that he was driving the vehicle, in which the prosecutrix was forcibly taken to Pushkar by the co-accused persons and subjected to forcible sexual assault.

Learned counsel further submitted that [2023:RJ-JD:35746] specific allegation of forcible sexual assault has been levelled by the prosecutrix upon co-accused persons namely Jitendra, Ramesh and Surendera Mundal.

Learned counsel further submitted that in view of the fact that there is no allegation against the present petitioner of committing forcible sexual assault upon the prosecutrix and the only allegation against the present petitioner is of driving the vehicle in which the prosecutrix was taken to Pushkar; the Dilip Singh vs State Of Rajasthan (2023:Rj-Jd:35746) on 18 October, 2023 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/41325707/

sentences.text: petitioner who is in judicial custody since 10.10.2023 and the investigation from present petitioner has already been completed, further incarceration of the present petitioner is not necessitated in the present case.
The trial of the case is likely to consume sufficiently long time.
On these grounds, he implored the Court to enlarge the petitioner on bail.
Per contra, learned Public Prosecutor has opposed the bail application.

Having considered the facts and circumstances of the case, this Court finds that the prosecutrix has levelled specific allegation of forcible sexual assault against the co-accused persons, without expressing any opinion on merits/demerits of the case, this Court is inclined to enlarge the petitioner on bail.
Consequently, the bail application under Section 439 Cr.P.C. is allowed.

It is ordered that the accused-petitioner Dilip Singh S/o Lal Singh arrested in connection with F.I.R. No.184/2023 registered at Police Station Kuchera, District Nagaur,, shall be released on bail, if not wanted in any other case, provided he furnishes a personal bond of Rs.50,000/- and two sureties of [2023:RJ-JD:35746] Rs.25,000/- each, to the satisfaction of learned trial court, for his appearance before that court on each & every date of hearing and whenever called upon to do so till completion of the trial.
(KULDEEP MATHUR),J 922-divya/-
